title: Weight of v(M, θ): finite on compact sets and ∫ g dμ_V = ∫_M θ g dHⁿ
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E := Ambient n ℓ = ℝ^{n+ℓ}, Hⁿ := μHE[n], and let a = (M, θ) be an admissible pair (a : RectifiablePair n ℓ: M is countably n-rectifiable and Hⁿ-null-measurable, θ(y) > 0 for y ∈ M, and θ is Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ E). Let μ := (mk a).weight be the weight of V = v(M, θ). Then (i) μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ E (IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ), and (ii) for every function g : E → ℝ, ∫ g dμ = ∫_M θ(y)·g(y) dHⁿ(y) (Bochner integrals, a non-integrable function having integral 0; the identity holds for all g).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (a : RectifiablePair n ℓ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts (mk a).weight ∧ ∀ g : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ, ∫ y, g y ∂(mk a).weight = ∫ y in a.M, a.θ y * g y ∂μHE[n]
